mechanics.claim: Each of Urgot's six legs conceals a shotgun that can fire once before going on its own unique cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Urgot's six legs each conceal a shotgun that covers an arc, together forming a full circle of cover around him. Each shotgun can fire once before incurring a unique {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: The effect is triggered by Urgot's next on-hit basic attack landing within a shotgun's arc, not by the attack itself.
mechanics.quote: '''Urgot's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} within the arc of a shotgun will cause it to fire in a cone, dealing

mechanics.claim: The damage is capped against monsters regardless of the AD/max-health ratios.
The effect will not trigger if the target is out of range or already dead when the basic attack lands.
mechanics.quote: Will not trigger if the target is too far away or they are dead when the basic attack hits.

mechanics.claim: The effect will not trigger while Urgot is blinded, or if the triggering basic attack is blocked by Wind Wall or Blade Whirl.
mechanics.quote: Will not trigger while {{tip|Blind|blinded}} or if the basic attack is blocked by {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} or {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}}.

mechanics.claim: The shotgun blast does not apply life steal, but does apply spell vamp and omnivamp.
mechanics.quote: Will not apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, but does apply on {{tip|spell vamp}} and {{tip|omnivamp}}.

mechanics.claim: The effect applies spell effects (on-hit/on-cast riders that key off spell damage).
